data.one_liner: High-performance matrix computation and linear algebra library with built-in SIMD support.
data.what_it_does: Provides 32-bit and 64-bit matrix and vector types, linear algebra solvers, decompositions, iterative methods, and CSR sparse matrix support. Uses contiguous typed-data storage and pure Dart SIMD APIs for acceleration without external FFI dependencies.
use_when: You need high-performance dense or sparse matrix computations in pure Dart.
You require linear algebra features like LU, QR, Cholesky, SVD, or PCA.
avoid_when: You require native BLAS/LAPACK bindings or GPU execution.
You need automatic differentiation or distributed matrix operations.
strengths: Uses built-in SIMD APIs without FFI or binary runtime dependencies.
Explicit 32-bit and 64-bit precision choices with continuous storage.
Broad coverage of direct linear algebra, decompositions, and iterative solvers.
weaknesses: Does not include native BLAS/LAPACK or GPU execution support.
Fails fast on shape and numerical preconditions rather than silent reshaping.
